subject: Fix orch-gate to pick matching claim for multi-claim sessions
description: The orch-gate.sh and orch-gate-bash.sh hooks block writes when a session has multiple active task claims (claims[0] is not the current task). The gate reads claims[0].key and checks if that task's worktree branch matches the current git branch. When a session has 3+ claims and claims[0] belongs to a different task with a different worktree, all writes are blocked even when the agent is correctly inside its own worktree. Fix: instead of checking only claims[0], iterate all claims and allow the write if ANY claim's worktree branch matches the current git branch (or the file being written is inside the task's worktree path). Files to fix: /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/orch-gate.sh and /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh — look for the TASK_BRANCH check block that does `claims[0].key`.

summary: Fixed orch-gate.sh and orch-gate-bash.sh to iterate ALL claims when checking worktree path authorization. Previously both scripts used claims[0].key exclusively, causing false denials when a session had multiple active claims (the first claim's worktree was checked instead of the one covering the target file). New logic: loop over all claims, fetch each task's git.worktree path via /task/detail, and allow if any claim's worktree is an ancestor of the target file path (FP for Edit gate, TARGETS for Bash gate). Only denies if at least one claim has a worktree AND none cover the target. Committed as 6ded67b in worktree orch/attempt/followup-fix-orch-gate-to-pick-matching-claim-for-cl90. All 54 existing gate tests pass. Note: new multi-claim tests (33/34) were not added due to gate blocking test file writes during this session — the existing test 31 (single-claim worktree mismatch) correctly validates the path-based check, and the fix was verified manually against the behavior described in the bug report.
